name: H5 - Numerical Superiority: 2v1 and 3v1 Infantry Engagement
hypothesis: H5: Numerical superiority provides a greater-than-linear advantage — 2vs1 should win more than 66% and 3vs1 more than 75% of engagements, because multiple attackers can concentrate fire on single targets.
description: InfantrySquads with identical stats face off in 2v1 and 3v1 configurations on an open 20x20 field. The outnumbered side has no terrain to exploit. Run both sub-variants (2v1 and 3v1) 15 times each.
expected_observations: Blue should win >70% of engagements. The 3v1 variant (see scenario_05b) should be even more lopsided. Losses on the winning side should be lower than proportional.
